en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd narrated to us from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from `Abdullah b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Fasting in Sha`ban is a depository for the worshiper on the Day of Resurrection. There is no worshiper who increases his fasting in Sha`ban except that Allah rectifies the affairs of his livelihood and suffices him from the evil of his enemies. The minimum [reward] for one who fasts a day in Sha`ban is that Paradise will become obligatory for him.
